# Digital Growth Studio

> AI-powered Meta Ads Analytics and Optimization Platform.

Digital Growth Studio is a SaaS application designed for marketers, advertisers, and agencies to connect their Meta Ads accounts, analyze performance, and receive automated, data-driven campaign recommendation summaries.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://digitalgrowthstudio.in/): Product overview, AI recommendations, creative analyser, copy analyser, pricing, and FAQs.
- [Meta Integration Guide](https://digitalgrowthstudio.in/meta-integration): Complete guide on how our platform connects with Meta Ads API, security scopes used, and user authorization flows.
- [Security](https://digitalgrowthstudio.in/security): Enterprise-grade security details, data encryption standards, and tenant isolation policies.
- [Help & Documentation](https://digitalgrowthstudio.in/help): Support guides and general instructions on utilizing the platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://digitalgrowthstudio.in/privacy): Details on user authentication, Meta Ads read-only access scopes, and data retention policies.
- [Terms of Service](https://digitalgrowthstudio.in/terms): Terms, usage policies, subscription parameters, and cancellation terms.
- [Data Deletion](https://digitalgrowthstudio.in/data-deletion): Complete step-by-step documentation on how users can request or execute deletion of their connected Meta Ad account data.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### Is Digital Growth Studio an agency?
No. Digital Growth Studio is an automated SaaS platform that connects directly to your Meta Ads account to provide instant performance analysis, creative breakdowns, and data-driven recommendations.

### Does it automatically edit or pause live campaigns?
No, the current version provides safe read-only analysis and clear optimization suggestions so you stay in total control. Automated execution options will be available in future releases.

### Do I need to share my Meta login password?
Never. You authenticate safely using Meta's official secure OAuth flow. We only request read-only access to campaign performance data.

### Can it pinpoint which ad copy or creative variation performs best?
Yes. Our system compares ad formats (Reels, Feed, Carousel), copy angles, and creative visual types to highlight top-performing components.

### How does the AI generate recommendations?
Our algorithm cross-analyzes ROAS, CPA, CTR, frequency, and conversion velocity against historical account baselines to flag ad fatigue, budget scaling opportunities, and waste.

### What is the Early Access pricing?
Our Early Access plan is currently locked in at just ₹99/month, including a free 7-day trial and all core features.

### Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
Yes, absolutely. You can manage or cancel your plan directly from your account settings with a single click.

### Is my advertising data secure?
Yes. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We use strict tenant isolation and enterprise-grade security standards.
